boot.h.reason: The helper supports the immutable .13 boot marker path; the bundled legacy app header is not the helper boot entry.

bootstrap.h.reason: The .13 manager uses a 15-second native runtime qualification bound; the app keeps its legacy helper copy.

http.h.reason: The application HTTP bridge accepts the separately qualified .13 manager digest.

native.h.reason: The .13 helper selects its immutable Camera Recovery path without the legacy Reap module.

profile-pins.h.reason: The helper has explicit stock13 compile-time native pins; the app snapshot retains legacy fallback pins.

profile_cache.h.reason: The .13 helper caches its qualified module paths; the app snapshot keeps the legacy module list.
